description: DbInstance is the Schema for the dbinstances API

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: Connection settings for the database server.

adminSecretRef.description:
Reference to the Secret containing database administrator credentials. The optional user key
defaults to postgres for PostgreSQL and root for MySQL. PostgreSQL passwords are read
from password, postgresql-password, or postgresql-postgres-password; MySQL passwords
are read from password or mysql-root-password.

allowExtraGrants.description:
Permits Database resources to grant access to existing users
through their extraGrants field.

allowedPrivileges.description:
Database roles that DbUser resources may request in extraPrivileges.
ALL PRIVILEGES is not allowed.

backup.description: Storage used by Database backup jobs.

engine.description:
Database engine. Supported values are postgres and mysql.
This field is immutable.

generic.description: Existing database server reachable by address and port.

backupHost.description: BackupAddress used by backup jobs. When empty, backup jobs use host.

host.description:
Address db-operator uses to connect to the database server.
It cannot be set with hostFrom.

hostFrom.description: Reference to one data entry in a Secret or ConfigMap.

key.description: Data key whose value should be read.

kind.description: Referenced resource kind. Supported values are Secret and ConfigMap.

port.description: Database server port. It cannot be set with portFrom.

portFrom.description: Reference to one data entry in a Secret or ConfigMap.

key.description: Data key whose value should be read.

kind.description: Referenced resource kind. Supported values are Secret and ConfigMap.

publicIp.description:
Externally reachable address exposed in generated credentials.
It cannot be set with publicIpFrom.

publicIpFrom.description: Reference to one data entry in a Secret or ConfigMap.

key.description: Data key whose value should be read.

kind.description: Referenced resource kind. Supported values are Secret and ConfigMap.

google.description:
Google Cloud SQL instance managed through the Google API.

Deprecated: Use generic instead. Google instances will be removed in v1beta2.

apiEndpoint.description: Overrides the Google SQL Admin API endpoint.

clientSecretRef.description: Reference to the Secret containing Google API client credentials.

configmapRef.description: Reference to a ConfigMap containing the Google instance configuration.

instanceVars.description:
Provides values to credential templates through the InstanceVar function.
For example, a template can expose the address of a read-only PostgreSQL replica.

enabled.description: Creates and configures a monitoring user for databases on this instance.

sslConnection.description: TLS settings for connections from db-operator to the database server.

skip-verify.description: Accepts a server certificate without verifying its certificate authority or hostname.

status.description: Observed state of the database server connection.

info.description: Contains DB_CONN, DB_PORT, and DB_PUBLIC_IP values discovered for the instance.

phase.description: One of Validating, Creating, Broadcasting, ProxyCreating, or Running.

status.description: True when the operator can connect to the database server.
